title: Optional modules
description: Core modules (packages/core/modules/), template vertical modules (templates/<name>/modules/), and how to install them.

blocks.text: The monorepo has two module layers. Core modules are cross-vertical features (SEO, gallery, footer) copied from packages/core/modules/. Template modules are vertical slices (hotel room-types, real-estate projects) maintained under templates/<directory>/modules/ with a template-modules.json registry.
Defined in packages/core/modules.json. Each module lists paths to copy, an optional prismaFragment, and a SITE.features flag.

rows: Site footer from SITE.footer and SITE.legal
Carousel hero from SITE.hero + hero assets
sitemap.xml, robots.txt, JSON-LD, Open Graph helpers
Privacy + terms pages from SITE config
Compose Blog Engine, BlogPost CMS, /blog, admin compose editor
Light/dark toggle, theme.colorsDark, dual admin palette editor

blocks.code:
# At template creation
pnpm new-template bakery --name "Bakery" --modules enquiry-modal,footer,hero-simple,seo

# Add to existing template
pnpm template:add-module bakery gallery,reviews
pnpm template:add-module list   # via scripts — see Maintainer commands

blocks.text: On install: copies module files, appends Prisma fragments to prisma/domain.prisma, merges prisma/schema.prisma, sets SITE.features.<flag> to true, writes .tempjs-modules.json (coreModules array). Scaffold templates get app/page.tsx wired; gallery/reviews also update app/admin/registry.ts on the unified dashboard.
After tempjs hotel in a client folder, add optional core modules with the same registry — no monorepo required.

Published CLI ships packages/core/modules/ and fetches from GitHub when not running from the monorepo. Client add-module updates registry.ts for gallery/reviews and does not overwrite app/page.tsx — add homepage sections manually or use scaffold patterns.
Shipped templates keep assembled files at the template root (what tempjs copies). Maintainers edit source under modules/<module-id>/ and sync with assemble/extract.

rows: Room inventory, grid, admin CRUD, room gallery page
/[slug] room details, hotel-config API, dynamic sitemap registration

blocks.text: Monorepo: add core module to template

Hotel adopts core seo, gallery, and reviews where they overlapped bespoke code. Real-estate adopts core seo. Dynamic listing URLs register via lib/hotel/register-sitemap.ts and lib/real-estate/register-sitemap.ts with buildAppSitemap(). Hotel keeps its bespoke app/gallery/page.tsx (room images) while homepage GallerySection uses the CMS module.

Gallery and reviews modules register tabs on the unified app/admin/page.tsx dashboard via app/admin/registry.ts (generated on scaffold install, merged on shipped templates). Scaffold templates get LeadsPanel, Theme & Colors, promo, and logo tabs from core. Hotel and real-estate add vertical tabs (room types, projects, facilities). Legacy app/admin/content/page.tsx is removed when gallery/reviews are installed.

blocks.title: How it works
blocks.text: lib/admin/AdminShell.tsx renders sidebar tabs from getAdminTabs(). Gallery/reviews tabs appear when SITE.features.gallery or SITE.features.reviews is true. pnpm new-template wires the dashboard and registry; tempjs add-module updates registry.ts for gallery/reviews on client projects (merges into vertical registries on hotel/real-estate copies).
